row.evidence: Oyster supports SSO for admin and manager roles (OIDC, SAML or its Okta OIDC app with an Okta event hook that deletes the Oyster account when a user is removed), but documents no SCIM endpoint and its API covers employments and payroll data, not admin users.
row.notes: Oyster (Oyster HR), employer-of-record and contractor platform priced per worker: EOR USD 699 per employee/month (annual discounts available), Global Contractors free for 30 days then USD 29 per contractor/month (monthly price shown), People Services USD 300/hour. No SCIM at any tier: the API docs (docs.oysterhr.com llms.txt, about 300 pages) and help centre (search: scim returns only an unrelated payroll article) document none. Admin and manager users can sign in via OIDC, SAML or the Okta OIN app (OIDC only, no SCIM). The Okta setup adds an Okta Event Hook (User suspended, User deactivated, User unassigned from app) to app.oysterhr.com/api/okta/events, which deletes the Oyster account; this is deprovision-only, so api_provisioning stays false. SSO only signs in existing accounts (no JIT sign-up), and team members (workers) cannot use SSO. No plan gate is stated for SSO. The Oyster API (OAuth2, read/manage/subscribe scopes) manages employments, contractors, offboarding and payroll data and can invite a hired team member to Oyster, but has no endpoints to list, create or remove admin users. New row.

plans.notes: Priced per employed worker. Seat-based annual billing at a reduced fee exists but no annual price is shown.

scim.notes: Not offered: SSO articles (OIDC, SAML, Okta) cover sign-in only, and the Okta integration deprovisions through an Okta Event Hook rather than SCIM.

endpoints.purpose: List engagements (hired workers), not admin users
Send the Oyster invitation to a hired team member

rate_limits.text: 300 requests per 5 minutes per company, burst 40 requests per second; 429 with Retry-After

user_api.notes: The API manages employments, contractors, offboarding, expenses, time off and invoices for workers. No documented endpoints for Oyster admin/manager users, roles or audit logs. Client-credentials access is restricted (request via api-support@oysterhr.com). API plan gate not stated.

okta.notes: OIN page markup ticks OIDC only (no SAML, no SCIM, no provisioning ticks). Oyster's guide adds an Okta Event Hook so suspending, deactivating or unassigning a user deletes the Oyster account (deprovision-only).

entra.notes: Not listed: no Oyster entry in the Entra SaaS app tutorials index; Oyster documents generic OIDC/SAML with Entra.

fallbacks.other_sync: Okta Event Hook deprovisioning (account deleted when user is suspended, deactivated or unassigned in Okta); Oyster also syncs worker data out to HRIS/payroll tools (HiBob, BambooHR, Workday, etc.) via integrations and API.
